messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays that fell in Canada in 2023. (Long weekends are usually created when a statutory holiday falls on a Friday or a Monday, giving you a three‑day break.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Type |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Sunday | **Extended** (4‑day weekend if you take Monday off) |
| Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Monday | **Long** |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | Friday | **Long** |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | Monday | **Long** |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Saturday | **Extended** (if you take Monday off) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | Monday | **Long** |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 (Monday) | Monday | **Long** |
| Remembrance Day (Ontario, Quebec, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland & Labrador) | Nov 11 (Monday) | Monday | **Long** |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) | Monday | **Long** |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | Tuesday | **Extended** (if you take Monday off) |

**Notes**

* Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.) that may create extra long weekends depending on how you schedule your time off.
* If you’re looking for a more detailed, province‑specific list, let me know and I can tailor it further!
